FEDERAL ROADS (PRIVATE MANAGEMENT) ACT 1984

FEDERAL ROADS (PRIVATE MANAGEMENT) (COLLECTION OF TOLLS)

[JITRA-SUNGAI DUA (BUTTERWORTH) EXPRESSWAY] (AMENDMENT) ORDER 2016

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 2 of

the Federal Roads (Private Management) Act 1984 [Act 306], the Minister makes

the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Federal Roads (Private Management)

(Collection of Tolls) [Jitra-Sungai Dua (Butterworth) Expressway] (Amendment)

Order 2016.

(2) This Order is deemed to have come into operation on 12 April 2012.

Amendment of paragraph 2

2. The Federal Roads (Private Management) (Collection of Tolls) [Jitra-Sungai Dua

(Butterworth) Expressway] Order 1989 [P.U. (A) 16/1989], which is referred to as the

"principal Order" in this Order, is amended in paragraph 2—

(a) in subparagraph (1)—

(i) by substituting for the words "Projek Lebuhraya Utara-Selatan

Berhad" the words "Projek Lebuh Raya Usahasama Berhad";

(ii) by substituting for the words "1st September 1993

to the 31st May 2018" the words "12 April 2012

to 31 December 2038"; and

(iii) by substituting for the words "column (2)" the words

"column (1)".;

(b) in subsubparagraph (1)(i), by deleting the words "according to the

concession years as specified in column (1) of the Schedule thereof"; and

(c) in subsubparagraph (1)(ii), by deleting the words "according to the

concession years as specified in column (1) of the Schedule thereof".

Substitution of First Schedule

3. The principal Order is amended by substituting for the First Schedule the

following Schedule:

"FIRST SCHEDULE

[Subparagraph 2(1)]

RATES OF TOLLS FOR THE PERIOD FROM 12 JANUARY 2012

UNTIL 31 DECEMBER 2016

(1)

Classes of Vehicles

(2)

Toll Payable

(RM)

1. Vehicle with two axles and three or four wheels

(excluding taxi and bus)

1.60

2. Vehicle with two axles and five or six wheels

(excluding bus)

2.30

3. Vehicle with three axles or more (excluding bus) 3.10

4. Taxi 0.80

5. Bus 1.20

For the purpose of calculating the number of axles and wheels of a vehicle, the axles and

wheels of any trailer towed by the vehicle shall be calculated as part of the axles and

wheels of the vehicle.".

Substitution of First Schedule—A

4. The principal Order is amended by substituting for the First Schedule—A the

following Schedule:

"FIRST SCHEDULE—A

[Subparagraph 2(1)]

For the purpose of calculating the number of axles and wheels of a vehicle, the axles and

Made 11 May 2016

[KKR.PUU.110-1/7/1 Jld.17(38); PN(PU2)426/LXIII]
